title: Az európai irodalom alapjai: Homérosztól Goethéig
grammar: Literary Attribution & Theme Framing: Alkotása, témája, megtestesítője

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can explain the themes and historical significance of Homer's Iliad and Odyssey.
I can discuss William Shakespeare's Renaissance tragedies (Romeo and Juliet, Hamlet) and their Hungarian reception.
I can characterize Enlightenment satire (Molière, Voltaire) and Johann Wolfgang von Goethe's Faust.
I can use Hungarian literary attribution structures to link authors, eras, and central themes.
